name: Aurus Capital Renta Inmobiliaria Fondo de Inversion
summary: Aurus Capital Renta Inmobiliaria Fondo de Inversión launched and managed by Aurus S.A. Gestión de Inversiones. The fund invests in the real estate markets of Chile. It seeks to invest in income generating properties. Aurus Renta Inmobiliaria Fund is domiciled in Chile.
